answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 6910 Country: MU Title: A man has asset valuing 10 million rupees, this includes his house, car and personal belongings. Alongside he has a debt of 4 million rupees. Is he allow to take zakaat? If yes, how much can he take? Question: Assalamualaikum Wa Rahmatullahi Wa Barakatuh A man has asset valuing 10 million rupees, this includes his house, car and personal belongings. Alongside he has a debt of 4 million rupees. Is he allow to take zakaat? If yes, how much can he take? Jazakumullah Wassalam Answer ID: 6910 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1522/1316=B/1429) As per the abovementioned question, he is allowed to receive zakah provided the assets are neither for business nor extra form needs and all things are in his use. He can receive Zakah as per his needs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
